newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's NYBB upgrades Pannonplast to buy.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's NYBB upgrades Pannonplast to buy.

text.p: Hungarian securities house New York Broker Budapest (NYBB) upgraded plastics industrial group Pannonplast to short-term and long-term "buy" from short-term "sell" and long-term "hold" it assigned in February.
"The short-term buy is at a limit of 9,250 forints," NYBB's analyst Gabriella Bor said in a company update.

"This (limit) means that it was worth for a short-term investor to wait for a correction of a few hundreds of forints, as a decline was possible," Bor said. "A long-term investor... should buy at market price," she added.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Pannonplast shares surged to a new record high of 9,680 forints on Wednesday before they retreated to finish at 9,575, up 424.
The analyst upgraded Pannonplast's ratings on the back of the group's first quarter earnings report and current market conditions, and supported her opinion by fundamental and technical grounds.

From fundamental side Bor praised that the company finances its expansions from own sources. Further value was that Pannonplast exceeded other plastics groups in the region by efficiency measured by the ratio of sales revenue per employee.

On the technical side, a steady pace of growth is forecast for Pannonplast's earnings per share, she said, adding "its price will probably follow that." She added she saw a support level at 9,085 forints.
